description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Material Document provides a way to interact with the [Material Document - Read, Create API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT_SRV/overview). The service allows to retrieve and create material documents, for example, to post a goods receipt for a purchase order or to document the transfer of materials between two storage locations, and to cancel existing material documents or single items.
key-features: Post goods movements such as goods receipts, goods issues and transfer postings as material documents
Read material document headers and items with OData query options
Cancel complete material documents or individual items
